title: backlog_close lists a sprint's close summary inline and deletes the finished sprint as a job of the operations service, annotated destructive
goal: With KB_BACKLOG_WRITE_TOOLS=1 the kb MCP server lists backlog_close (sprint, summary, commit, trailer); a call with summary true runs backlog.main close --summary in-process, prints the CLI's text and submits no job (close --summary with commit is refused as the CLI refuses it); any other call parses its argv and submits ops_service.submit('close', argv, item=SPRINT), returning the job record, so the CLI's refusal of an unfinished sprint, its ops row and its worker cleanup all run in the job and none is reimplemented; annotations: readOnlyHint false, destructiveHint true, idempotentHint false, openWorldHint false

run: import sys,os,subprocess,tempfile,importlib;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");os.environ["KB_BACKLOG_WRITE_TOOLS"]="1";[os.environ.pop(k,None) for k in ("CLAUDECODE","CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION")];R=os.getcwd();d=tempfile.mkdtemp();open(d+"/ops_service.py","w").write("CALLS=[];submit=lambda verb,argv,item=None,session=None:(CALLS.append((verb,argv,item)),{\"job\":\"J-test0003\",\"verb\":verb,\"item\":item,\"state\":\"queued\"})[1]");sys.path.insert(0,d);importlib.invalidate_caches();import kb_mcp,ops_service;a=tempfile.mkdtemp();g=lambda *x:subprocess.run(["git","-C",a,*x],check=True,capture_output=True);g("init","-q");g("config","user.email","a@example.com");g("config","user.name","n");sp=subprocess.run([sys.executable,R+"/_tools/backlog.py","--root",a,"new","sprint","--title","Planted sprint"],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.split()[2];g("add","-A");g("commit","-qm","plant");os.chdir(a);call=lambda n,**k:kb_mcp.handle({"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":n,"arguments":k}})["result"];tools={t["name"]:t for t in kb_mcp.tool_list()};assert tools["backlog_close"]["annotations"]["destructiveHint"] is True,"annotations";call("backlog_close",sprint=sp,summary=True);assert not ops_service.CALLS,"summary submitted a job";assert call("backlog_close",sprint=sp,summary=True,commit=True)["isError"],"summary with commit accepted";r=call("backlog_close",sprint=sp);assert not r["isError"] and ops_service.CALLS and ops_service.CALLS[0][0]=="close" and ops_service.CALLS[0][1][:2]==["close",sp],(r,ops_service.CALLS)

gates.question: Serve backlog_close, which deletes a finished sprint with its items, as a kb MCP job tool?
options: Serve it as a destructive job tool, with close --summary inline
Serve only close --summary inline and keep the deleting close on Bash
gates.recommendation: Serve it as a destructive job tool, with close --summary inline
gates.reason: because the CLI refuses an unfinished sprint, git keeps the deleted files and the Bash route allows the same command
gates.answer: Serve it as a destructive job tool, with close --summary inline

notes: Interface (orchestrator, 2026-11-08): the job submit and follow interface is the ops-service half's, kj_store.submit(root, op, subject, by, options=None, store=None) -> {job, state, deduped, seq, follow} and kj_store.status(root, job, since=0, store=None) -> {job, state, exit, step, log, events, last} (ST-nwwcf3kk), followed with kbjob.py follow (ST-5h2kx2ri); the ops_service.submit name in this item's notes is replaced by it.
